Safety Precaution
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل

The maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety and healthy 
equipment as safety helmet, shoes, gloves
 etc.
Shutdown the unit.
Generator should be isolated.
Isolate the circuit breaker of Generator
Disconnect the electric terminals of Generator

The oil of turbine must be isolated mechanically by closing delivery and 
 suction valves.
Be sure turbine must be completely drained.

sections.text: The Set measurement before Inspection

After dismounting the covers from bearing stands 
indicate the couplings are connected by fitted bolts, the rotors must be cold 
and temperature should not exceed 25 30 C.

Loosen the couplings and dismount fitted bolts, 
check the rotor alignment in the couplings Fig. 7 , 8.

After measurement dismount the tops of turbine 
casings and carry out:
Indication ( run out ) of rotor LP Fig. 6.

Inspect the rotor alignment in the couplings 
(casings are lifted) compare with covered casings . Now set the rotor into 
working position and set the couplings one on to the other, measure them.

خلوص محوري بين الحركة والدليل 
العجلات شكل 5، 9 .

An axial and radial clearance of labyrinth rings 
in the casings and guide wheels Fig. 4.
Align the MP LP bearing pedestals Fig. 10.

The upper and lateral clearance of journal 
bearings Fig. 11.

Before bulling out the rotors measure alignment 
with a recess in bearing stands and check the fitting of shaft.

After removal of rotor, insert a check shaft into 
turbine casings, set it according to the values from rotor alignment with a 
recess of bearing stands and measure the alignment of seal bodies and of guide 
wheels in a shaft of the high-pressure medium-pressure and a low- pressure part.

After the measurement dismount the seal bodies, 
the inner casings and carriers with guide wheels. Measure the evenness of 
parting planes by laying the tops of casings onto bottoms. Measure by slot 
plates from outside and inside. Admissible deflection of non-evenness of parting 
planes in new machines is 0,10 0,15 , in old machines 0,30 0,40 clearance 
between the bottom and top of the casing.
